newspaper.quote: Paper: newspaper, magazines, paperboard cereal boxes, and office paper

magazines-catalogs.quote: Paper: newspaper, magazines, paperboard cereal boxes, and office paper

office-paper.quote: Paper: newspaper, magazines, paperboard cereal boxes, and office paper

paperboard-box.quote: Paper: newspaper, magazines, paperboard cereal boxes, and office paper

cardboard-box.quote: Cardboard: flatten cardboard so it takes up less room. Labels and tape are okay

pizza-box-greasy.quote: Food soiled and shredded paper: pizza boxes, napkins, paper towels, greasy food wrappers, and dirty plain paper plates

paper-plates-napkins.quote: Food soiled and shredded paper: pizza boxes, napkins, paper towels, greasy food wrappers, and dirty plain paper plates

shredded-paper.quote: Food soiled and shredded paper: pizza boxes, napkins, paper towels, greasy food wrappers, and dirty plain paper plates

paper-takeout-container.quote: Uncoated paper containers, plates, bowls, and pizza boxes are compostable.
paper-takeout-container.note: Coated (shiny) paper items are recycled instead.

paper-cup-hot.quote: Empty, clean, and dry paper items with a shiny (plastic) coating.

beverage-carton.quote: Paper Mixed-waste paper, cardboard, newspaper, poly-coated paper, and aseptic packaging

pet-bottle.quote: Plastic containers, bottles, jug and tubs: milk jugs, plastic soap bottles, yogurt and sauce tubs

hdpe-jug.quote: Plastic containers, bottles, jug and tubs: milk jugs, plastic soap bottles, yogurt and sauce tubs

plastic-tub.quote: Plastic containers, bottles, jug and tubs: milk jugs, plastic soap bottles, yogurt and sauce tubs

plastic-clamshell.quote: Plastic bottles, jars, tubs, cups, and food containers (excluding expanded polystyrene or Styrofoam)

plastic-cup-disposable.quote: Plastic bottles, jars, tubs, cups, and food containers (excluding expanded polystyrene or Styrofoam)

bottle-caps.quote: Other garbage: broken dishes, hoses, dryer lint, loose bottle caps, kitchen grease
bottle-caps.note: Loose caps are garbage; the SPU flyer says loose lids must be 3 inches or wider.

plastic-bag-film.quote: Plastics bags, wraps & wrappers: frozen food bags, candy wrappers, produce sticker, dirty food containers and plastic bags

chip-bag-wrapper.quote: Plastics bags, wraps & wrappers: frozen food bags, candy wrappers, produce sticker, dirty food containers and plastic bags

foam-block.quote: Foam: trays, instant food container, and foam blocks
foam-block.note: Seattle also offers a free special-item pickup for clean foam blocks.

foam-food-container.quote: Foam: trays, instant food container, and foam blocks

garden-hose-tangler.quote: Other garbage: broken dishes, hoses, dryer lint, loose bottle caps, kitchen grease

aluminum-can.quote: Metal cans and scrap: aluminum cans, steel cans and clean foil trays

steel-can.quote: Metal cans and scrap: aluminum cans, steel cans and clean foil trays

aluminum-foil.quote: Tin cans, aluminum cans, pots, pans, foil, and scrap metal larger than 3 inches but smaller than two feet in any direction and less than 35 pounds

scrap-metal.quote: Tin cans, aluminum cans, pots, pans, foil, and scrap metal larger than 3 inches but smaller than two feet in any direction and less than 35 pounds

glass-bottle-jar.quote: Glass bottles and jars: no drink glasses or window glass

mirror-window-glass.quote: Glass bottles and jars: no drink glasses or window glass

ceramic-dishware.quote: Other garbage: broken dishes, hoses, dryer lint, loose bottle caps, kitchen grease

food-scraps.quote: All food scraps and waste: if at one point you could have eaten it, it's compostable

yard-trimmings.quote: Yard waste, plants and clean wood: branches, leaves, and unpainted wood

clean-wood.quote: Yard waste, plants and clean wood: branches, leaves, and unpainted wood

compostable-plastic.quote: Approved compostable food packaging: it must say "Compostable" on it
compostable-plastic.note: Items marked compostable, BPI or PLA are not recyclable.

diapers-hygiene.quote: Diapers & pet waste; Hygiene products & protective equipment

electronics.quote: Do not put electronics, hazardous, and medical waste in the garbage.

battery-alkaline.quote: Special item collections: Batteries & Fluorescent Light Bulbs

battery-lithium.quote: Special item collections: Batteries & Fluorescent Light Bulbs

light-bulb-fluorescent.quote: Special item collections: Batteries & Fluorescent Light Bulbs

household-chemicals.quote: Household hazardous waste: Cleaners & Chemicals; Gasoline & Fuel
